name: Mother Nature
overview: Scripture reveals that God created man in His image and granted him dominion over all the earth and its creatures, entrusting humanity with the responsibility to steward and care for creation (Genesis 1:26, 1:28). Man was formed from the dust of the ground and given life by God's breath, emphasizing both his connection to the earth and his unique status as a living soul (Genesis 2:7). The Lord placed man in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and protect it, highlighting a divinely appointed role of stewardship rather than worship of nature itself (Genesis 2:15). Additionally, creation itself testifies to God's glory and wisdom, as seen in the teachings of the beasts and the praises of the psalmist, pointing believers to honor the Creator above His creation (Job 12:7; Psalms 8:1).
